points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 纳赛尔出生于亚历山大一个普通邮政职员家庭。他的童年主要在亚历山大和开罗度过。1924年，父亲被调往开罗，纳赛尔随家人迁往首都。在亚历山大期间，他接受了早期教育，并开始接触民族主义思想。这段时期对他后来的政治理念形成产生了深远影响，特别是对埃及民族独立和摆脱外国控制的渴望。
points.descriptionEn: Nasser was born in Alexandria to a middle-class family. His childhood was divided between Alexandria and Cairo. In 1924, his family moved to the capital when his father was transferred. During his time in Alexandria, he received his early education and began to develop nationalist ideas. This period profoundly influenced his later political philosophy, particularly his desire for Egyptian national independence and freedom from foreign control.

points.title: 军校求学
points.description: 1935年，纳赛尔进入埃及皇家军事学院学习。在军校期间，他结识了包括安瓦尔·萨达特在内的未来革命伙伴。他积极参与反英活动，多次因政治抗议被短暂监禁。这段军事训练和政治活动为他后来的军事政变奠定了基础。纳赛尔在军校期间开始形成自己的政治理念，强调埃及的民族独立和社会公正。
points.descriptionEn: In 1935, Nasser entered the Royal Military Academy in Cairo. During his time at the academy, he met future revolutionary comrades including Anwar Sadat. He actively participated in anti-British activities and was briefly imprisoned several times for political protests. This military training and political activism laid the foundation for his later coup. Nasser began to form his political ideology during this period, emphasizing Egyptian national independence and social justice.

points.title: 自由军官运动
points.description: 二战期间，纳赛尔在苏丹和埃及服役，晋升为上尉。1945年，他与志同道合的军官组建了秘密组织'自由军官运动'，目标是推翻君主制和结束英国对埃及的占领。1950年，他成为该组织领导人。在此期间，他策划了1952年7月23日军事政变，推翻了法鲁克国王。这一阶段是纳赛尔政治生涯的关键转折点，使他从一个普通军官转变为埃及革命的领导者。
points.descriptionEn: During World War II, Nasser served in Sudan and Egypt, rising to the rank of captain. In 1945, he formed the secret 'Free Officers Movement' with like-minded officers, aiming to overthrow the monarchy and end British occupation of Egypt. By 1950, he had become the leader of the organization. During this period, he planned the July 23, 1952 military coup that overthrew King Farouk. This phase marked a critical turning point in Nasser's political career, transforming him from an ordinary officer to the leader of the Egyptian Revolution.

points.title: 权力巩固
points.description: 政变后，纳赛尔最初担任埃及总理，1956年正式成为总统。他废除了君主制，宣布埃及为共和国，并推动了一系列社会改革，包括土地改革和教育普及。1954年，他挫败了穆斯林兄弟会的暗杀企图，随后取缔该组织。1955年，他在万隆会议上崭露头角，开始在国际舞台上发挥影响力。这一时期，他逐渐巩固了自己的权力，为后续的阿拉伯民族主义政策奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: After the coup, Nasser initially served as Prime Minister of Egypt and became president in 1956. He abolished the monarchy, declared Egypt a republic, and implemented a series of social reforms including land reform and educational expansion. In 1954, he survived an assassination attempt by the Muslim Brotherhood, subsequently banning the organization. Nasser emerged as a prominent international figure at the 1955 Bandung Conference. During this period, he gradually consolidated his power, laying the foundation for his subsequent Arab nationalist policies.

points.title: 苏伊士危机与泛阿拉伯主义
points.description: 1956年，纳赛尔宣布将苏伊士运河收归国有，引发第二次中东战争（苏伊士危机）。在美苏压力下，英法军队撤出，纳赛尔取得重大政治胜利，声望达到顶峰。他随后推动'阿拉伯联合共和国'与叙利亚合并，并支持阿尔及利亚等国的民族解放运动。在国内，他实施国有化政策，推动工业化，修建阿斯旺高坝。这一时期是纳赛尔政治生涯的高峰，他的泛阿拉伯主义思想影响了整个中东地区。
points.descriptionEn: In 1956, Nasser nationalized the Suez Canal, triggering the Second Arab-Israeli War (Suez Crisis). Under pressure from the US and USSR, British and French forces withdrew, giving Nasser a major political victory and elevating his prestige to its peak. He then promoted the formation of the 'United Arab Republic' with Syria and supported national liberation movements in Algeria and other countries. Domestically, he implemented nationalization policies, promoted industrialization, and constructed the Aswan High Dam. This period marked the pinnacle of Nasser's political career, as his pan-Arabist ideas influenced the entire Middle East region.

points.title: 六日战争与晚年
points.description: 1967年六日战争中，埃及军队惨败于以色列，西奈半岛被占领，这是纳赛尔政治生涯的重大挫折。他随后宣布辞职，但大规模民众抗议迫使他继续执政。战争后，他转向苏联寻求更多军事援助，同时调整国内政策，放宽对经济的控制。1969-1970年，他发动'消耗战争'，试图从以色列手中夺回失地。1970年9月28日，纳赛尔因心脏病突发在开罗去世，享年52岁。他的葬礼吸引了数百万民众，成为现代史上规模最大的葬礼之一。
points.descriptionEn: In the 1967 Six-Day War, Egypt suffered a devastating defeat to Israel, losing the Sinai Peninsula, which was a major setback in Nasser's political career. He subsequently announced his resignation but massive popular protests forced him to remain in power. After the war, he turned to the Soviet Union for more military aid while adjusting domestic policies by relaxing economic controls. In 1969-1970, he initiated the 'War of Attrition' attempting to regain lost territory from Israel. On September 28, 1970, Nasser died of a sudden heart attack in Cairo at the age of 52. His funeral attracted millions of people, becoming one of the largest funerals in modern history.

supporter.zh: 纳赛尔被视为阿拉伯民族主义的象征和埃及现代化的奠基人。支持者赞扬他结束了外国对埃及的控制，实现了苏伊士运河国有化，推动了社会改革和工业化。他倡导的阿拉伯团结和反殖民主义精神激励了整个中东地区的民族解放运动。纳赛尔的教育普及政策和土地改革改善了普通埃及人的生活，他的泛阿拉伯主义理想至今仍影响着中东政治格局。
supporter.en: Nasser is regarded as a symbol of Arab nationalism and a founder of Egyptian modernization. Supporters praise him for ending foreign control over Egypt, nationalizing the Suez Canal, and promoting social reforms and industrialization. His advocacy for Arab unity and anti-colonialism inspired national liberation movements throughout the Middle East. Nasser's education policies and land reforms improved the lives of ordinary Egyptians, and his pan-Arab ideals continue to influence the Middle Eastern political landscape.

critic.zh: 批评者指责纳赛尔实行独裁统治，压制政治自由和公民权利。他取缔反对党，限制言论自由，建立了秘密警察系统。经济上，他的国有化政策导致效率低下和经济困境。外交上，他与苏联的密切关系使埃及成为冷战代理人，六日战争的失败严重削弱了埃及的军事力量。此外，他对巴勒斯坦问题的处理方式也受到批评，一些人认为他利用巴勒斯坦事业服务于自身政治议程。
critic.en: Critics accuse Nasser of implementing authoritarian rule, suppressing political freedoms and civil rights. He banned opposition parties, restricted freedom of speech, and established a secret police system. Economically, his nationalization policies led to inefficiency and economic difficulties. Diplomatically, his close ties with the Soviet Union made Egypt a proxy in the Cold War, and Egypt's defeat in the Six-Day War severely weakened its military strength. Additionally, his handling of the Palestinian issue has been criticized, with some arguing he exploited the Palestinian cause for his own political agenda.

objective.zh: 历史学界普遍认为纳赛尔是20世纪最具影响力的中东领导人之一。他代表了后殖民时代阿拉伯民族主义的高潮，其政策既有进步性也有局限性。在流行文化中，纳赛尔被符号化为反抗西方霸权的象征，他的形象出现在无数电影、文学和艺术作品中。尽管他的泛阿拉伯主义理想未能完全实现，但他对中东政治、社会和文化的深远影响持续至今，塑造了现代埃及和阿拉伯世界的集体记忆与政治想象。
objective.en: Historians generally regard Nasser as one of the most influential Middle Eastern leaders of the 20th century. He represented the zenith of post-colonial Arab nationalism, with policies that were both progressive and limited. In popular culture, Nasser has been symbolized as a resistance against Western hegemony, with his image appearing in countless films, literary works, and art pieces. Although his pan-Arabist ideals were never fully realized, his profound impact on Middle Eastern politics, society, and culture continues to shape the collective memory and political imagination of modern Egypt and the Arab world.

self.zh: 革命不是一场宴会，不是一首诗，也不是一幅画；革命是专政。
self.en: The revolution is not a dinner party, or writing an essay, or painting a picture, or doing embroidery; the revolution is an insurrection, an act of violence by which one class overthrows another.

others.zh: 纳赛尔是阿拉伯世界最伟大的领导人，他给了阿拉伯民族尊严和希望。
others.en: Nasser was the greatest leader in the Arab world, he gave the Arab nation dignity and hope.
